data.cultural_impact: The name Svetoslav was commonly used among the medieval Slavic populations of Europe. Many rulers and saints bore this name, including the Grand Prince of Bulgaria and the Duke of Serbia. Svetoslav is also the name of a 10th-century Bulgarian ruler known for his military prowess and, according to legend, his refugees' protection and kindness.
